claims.reason: browser-host.cjs:1656-1674 signals Manual cancellation, swallows cancelTurn rejection, and removes the running exact-owner tab; main.cjs:1294 wires cancelTurn to runtimeSupervisor.cancelBrowserTurn, so runtime cancellation can remain unacknowledged while the local owner is released.

control-server.cjs:262-265 dispatches /v1/manual/cancel to browser-host.cjs:2312-2319, where exact trace/helper ownership is checked but cancelTurn is never invoked before signalManualTerminal and removeTurnTab; HTTP success therefore does not prove runtime cancellation.

roots.title: Manual cancellation releases the exact browser owner before runtime cancellation is acknowledged
roots.trigger: A running Manual turn is closed while cancelTurn rejects, or an authenticated /v1/manual/cancel request reaches cancelManualTurn; the local terminal record and browser tab are released even though the launcher-owned runtime was not targeted or did not acknowledge cancellation.
roots.fix: Use one exact-owner cancellation path for Manual close and /v1/manual/cancel. Target runtime cancellation before releasing a running tab, preserve a pending/failed cancellation state on rejection, and return success only after acknowledgement or an explicit recoverable pending result. Keep the existing public connector ABI and names unchanged.
